claim_text: Based on what we know today and using current methodologies for GHG emission accounting, we remain on track to meet our medium-term target to reduce operational GHG emissions (Scopes 1 and 2 emissions from our operated assets) by at least 30 per cent by FY2030 from an FY2020 baseline.
metric_name: Operational GHG emissions reduction from FY2020 baseline; Operational GHG emissions FY2025; Operational GHG emissions FY2024
context_text: Based on what we know today and using current methodologies for GHG emission accounting, we remain on track to meet our medium-term target to reduce operational GHG emissions (Scopes 1 and 2 emissions from our operated assets) by at least 30 per cent by FY2030 from an FY2020 baseline. We have not used carbon credits or applied offsetting in our assessment that we are on track to meet our medium-term target.；For FY2025, our operational GHG emissions were 36 per cent lower than our FY2020 baseline, a further 4 percent improvement against our FY2020 baseline compared to 32 per cent in FY2024 (baseline year and performance data adjusted). Operational GHG emissions in FY2025 were 8.7 MtCO2-e, which is 5 per cent less than operational emissions of 9.2 MtCO2-e in FY2024 (performance data adjusted).
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: FY2025运营Scope 1和2排放已较FY2020基线下降36%，高于2030年前至少下降30%的中期目标门槛，证据直接且量化支持claim。
notes: claim 自带目标描述，证据取自同页实际绩效数据。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company is “on track” to achieve at least a 30% reduction in operational Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by FY2030 versus an FY2020 baseline. The provided evidence only gives a 36% figure and operational GHG emissions values for FY2025 (8.7 MtCO2-e) and FY2024 (9.2 MtCO2-e), but it does not provide the FY2020 baseline emissions, does not explicitly state that the 36% reduction is relative to FY2020, and does not connect these figures to a trajectory assessment showing it is “on track” to FY2030. Without the baseline and an explicit linkage of the reduction percentage and/or FY2024–FY2025 values to the FY2030 target pathway, the evidence does not substantively verify the “on track to meet 30% by FY2030 from FY2020” claim as written.
